test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 9 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is **Solvant**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct word is **Solvent** in English. But the given second option is **Solvant**. The term 'solvant' does not exist in the English language,
 
• A solute can be dissolved by a solvent, which creates a **solution**.
 
• Refer to a sentence as an example.
 
 
• ***Example:** Ram can not stay **solvent** after losing his business.**​*
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's explain the other given options.
 
• A **membrane** is a thin layer of tissue that lines an organ, cavity, or other space. The word is absolutely correct.
 
 
• ***Example: **The lateral septa means the vascular **membranes**.*
 
 
 
• The third option is **Highlight**. The brightest area or spot is called a highlight.
 
 
• ***Example: **I saw the **highlight** of the video.*
 
 
 
• Exuberant refers to being genuinely happy and enthusiastic. Let's look at the example.
 
 
• ***Example:** Her excitement was a little **exuberant**.*
 
 
 
• The above options are all correct without **Solvant**.
